claims.text: Grand Hyatt Bali is a family-friendly beachfront resort in Nusa Dua, Bali.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Bali is a family-friendly beachfront resort in Nusa Dua, Bali.

claims.text: Rooms, suites and villas are set across four villages, all designed in contemporary Balinese style.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Bali features 636 luxury rooms, suites and villas across four villages, all designed in contemporary Balinese style.
findings.note: States four villages in contemporary Balinese style.

claims.text: Guest rooms have teakwood and marble floors from Central Java, a marble bath with a separate shower and a private balcony.

findings.quote: Teakwood and marble from Central Java grace the floors of this 49-square-meter room furnished with a plush king bed, a sofa bed, a marble bath with a separate shower, and a private balcony.
findings.note: Covers the floors, marble bath with separate shower and private balcony.

claims.text: Ocean-view rooms have a private balcony overlooking the Indian Ocean's white sandy beaches.

findings.quote: This beautiful 49-square-meter room is furnished with a plush king bed, a sofa bed, a marble bath with a separate shower, and a private balcony overlooking the Indian Ocean's white sandy beaches.

claims.text: The villas include a private pool.

findings.quote: 3 villas that include a private pool

claims.text: The resort has five swimming pools.

findings.quote: Our luxurious Balinese swim resort features five swimming pools designed to suit your holiday needs.

claims.text: At the Oceania Kids Club, children learn about Balinese culture and explore the resort's local flora and fauna.

findings.quote: allowing your little ones to learn about Balinese culture and explore the resort’s local flora and fauna in a safe and welcoming setting

claims.text: The Bay Club Fitness Center has cardio equipment, machine weights, squash courts and a yoga studio.

findings.quote: the Bay Club Fitness Center offers a variety of cardio equipment and machine weights, squash courts and a yoga studio.

claims.text: The rooftop Salsa Bar has panoramic views of the Nusa Dua coastline.

findings.quote: Enjoy Italian fare at Salsa Verde or a romantic rooftop night at our Salsa Bar with panoramic views of the Nusa Dua coastline.
findings.note: Rooftop Salsa Bar with panoramic coastline views.

claims.text: Wedding venues range from tropical gardens to a white, sandy beachfront.

findings.quote: From beautifully manicured tropical gardens to a white, sandy beachfront, Grand Hyatt Bali offers numerous venues for weddings and receptions.

claims.text: The resort is steps from the Bali Collection shopping center.

findings.quote: Located just minutes from a world-class convention center and steps from the Bali Collection shopping center.

claims.text: The hotel is 15 minutes from Ngurah Rai International Airport.

findings.quote: Just 15 minutes from Ngurah Rai International Airport
The hotel is just 15 minutes from the Ngurah Rai International Airport.

claims.text: The secluded Balinese Feature Pool has emerald green water and cascading waterfalls.

findings.quote: Find your peace at our secluded Balinese Feature Pool, with emerald green water and cascading waterfalls

claims.text: The lagoon-style Main Pool is surrounded by tropical gardens, and the River Pool has two waterslides.

findings.quote: Spend the day in the spacious lagoon-style Main Pool surrounded by tropical gardens, or ride down our two waterslides in the River Pool.

claims.text: Kriya Spa draws inspiration from Balinese water palaces and offers bespoke spa and wellness treatments by trained therapists.

findings.quote: Drawing inspiration from Balinese water palaces, Kriya Spa offers bespoke spa and wellness treatments delivered by professionally trained therapists.

claims.text: At Pasar Senggol, guests dine in an open-air amphitheatre while watching live Balinese cultural performances.

findings.quote: Enjoy your meal in an open-air amphitheatre while being entertained by live Balinese cultural performances.

claims.text: The One-Bedroom Beachfront Villa has Balinese decor, a dining area, a living area, a library and an outdoor patio with ocean views.

findings.quote: Opulent Balinese décor welcomes guests in this grand 175-square-meter villa that features a plush king bed, a dining area, a living area, a library and an outdoor patio with ocean views.

claims.text: The hotel no longer provides bottled water or disposable in-room amenities; guests are advised to bring their own essentials and a drinking vessel to refill.

findings.quote: our hotel no longer provides bottled water or disposable in-room amenities for staying guests
findings.note: No bottled water or disposable amenities.

findings.quote: We recommend bringing your own essentials and a drinking vessel to refill with drinking water available throughout the hotel.
findings.note: Advice to bring essentials and vessel.

claims.text: The Grand Club Pool is reserved for club guests.

findings.quote: The Grand Club Pool is exclusively available for our club guests.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the large resort may feel less intimate.
